hero.title: Pharmacy in Mauritius
hero.subtitle: Studying pharmacy in Mauritius may be an option for students interested in medicines, pharmaceutical sciences, patient care and the healthcare industry. **Pharmacy in Mauritius for Indian Students** can be an option to explore, but before selecting a university, students should check whether the programme is currently offered, whether it meets professional pharmacy registration requirements and whether the qualification will be recognised in their intended country of practice. Students planning to **Study Pharmacy in Mauritius** should carefully review these details before applying.

overview: The Pharmacy Council of Mauritius regulates the pharmacy profession, including pharmacist registration, approved training and professional standards. Its guidance is especially important for students planning to work in Mauritius after graduation. **Edu-Hawk Worldwide** encourages students to verify course recognition and professional requirements before making an admission decision.

faq.question: Can Indian students study pharmacy in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Indian students can explore eligible programmes, but should confirm admission requirements, international-student eligibility and recognition of the exact qualification before enrolling. Edu-Hawk Worldwide can help students understand the course and admission considerations for Pharmacy in Mauritius for Indian Students.

faq.question: How many years does it take to study pharmacy in Mauritius?
faq.answer: The duration depends on the course. The Pharmacy Council’s published criteria for registration refer to a full-time pharmacy qualification of at least four years, excluding pre-registration training. Confirm the duration of the specific programme.

faq.question: What is the cost of studying pharmacy in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Costs vary by institution and programme. Obtain an official fee schedule that includes tuition, registration, practical training and other compulsory charges before comparing universities.

faq.question: Can I work as a pharmacist in Mauritius after graduation?
faq.answer: You must satisfy the Pharmacy Council’s professional registration requirements. These can include an eligible pharmacy qualification, approved pre-registration training and the required examination, subject to the applicable rules and exemptions.

faq.question: Is a pharmacy degree from Mauritius recognised in India?
faq.answer: Recognition is not automatic. Before enrolling, confirm the current requirements with the relevant Indian authorities for pharmacy education and registration, including the Pharmacy Council of India and the applicable State Pharmacy Council. Verify the specific institution, course, awarding body and qualification rather than relying only on general university recognition.
